title: Cookbook Index
description: An alphabetically grouped index of terms and their associated entry identifiers or cross-references.

TermEntry.title: Index Term
TermEntry.description: A term linked to one or more entry identifiers.

recipe_number.description: The associated entry identifier or range (e.g., '1652' or '2104-6').

CrossReferenceEntry.title: Index Cross-Reference
CrossReferenceEntry.description: A term that redirects the reader to another index term.

see.description: The preferred term to look up instead (e.g., 'Apricots').

IndexEntry.title: Index Entry
IndexEntry.description: A standard term entry, a cross-reference, or both (some entries carry a recipe number and a see-also redirect simultaneously).

IndexGroup.title: Index Group
IndexGroup.description: All index entries that begin with a given letter of the alphabet.

letter.description: The single uppercase letter heading this group.
